verdict.rationale: Skyvern documents choosing a plan, tracking credits and setting organization limits, and it has a public pricing page. However, the evidence never shows actual per-task or per-browser-hour prices, or any published rate or concurrency limits. Missing for 10: concrete published per-task/per-hour or per-credit prices, documented API rate limits, documented concurrency limits per plan, independent corroboration of pricing transparency.

support.subject: As a developer, I can see transparent per-task or per-browser-hour pricing and documented rate/concurrency limits before committing

citations.quote: choose a plan, track credits, and set organization limits and models
You're replacing brittle Selenium scripts, integrating browser automation via API, or building workflows into your product.
